label: Delimiter / end-of-input in long sequences (L>=8)
explanation: Reset-gate unit that fires around the end of the original input in long sequences. It is strongest on the <DEL> step (64% of activation mass, top activations all at <DEL>), and fires there at 82% for L>=8 versus almost never for L<=6. It also fires more weakly on the last original token (orig_idx 8 when L=9, 57% rate) and on the first few copy steps (recall_idx 1-3), where it depends on the token and is weaker. Length drives magnitude: L=9 holds 71% of the mass, L=8 holds 25%, and it never fires for L<=5. It never fires at t<=5 or on original positions 0-6. The predicate misses the scattered weak copy-phase activations, and it has false positives on the last original token of L=8 sequences and on some delimiters.
